name: Shin NOZOKI-ma 2 ~Jogakuryou no Himitsu~
source:
After awakening his “peculiar talent” for peeping in the previous installment, True NOZOKI Demon: Peeping at the Boarding House 24/7, the protagonist, Ryouta Nozokibara, is back.
This time, the prestigious Saint Vermore Academy—known for its tradition and prestige—is renovating its female teachers’ dormitory.
As a result, a new group of targets arrives at the boarding house where Ryouta lives.

With the boarding house temporarily transformed into a women’s dorm, Ryouta’s new challenge begins!
Peep into their private lives!
Expose their secrets!
Grab hold of their weaknesses!
And then… play with their bodies to your heart’s content!

[Translated from [url=https://www.dlsite.com/pro/work/=/product_id/VJ006986.html/]dlsite[/url]]
